## Summary

Describe the change and why it is useful.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Accessibility improvement
- [ ] Security improvement
- [ ] Privacy improvement
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build or development tooling
- [ ] Other

## Testing

Describe how the change was tested.

## Required checks

- [ ] I ran `npm ci` from the lockfile when validating a clean dependency installation.
- [ ] I ran `npm run verify`.
- [ ] I tested the affected behavior on Windows 11 when applicable.
- [ ] I did not commit `node_modules/`, `dist/`, temporary builds, credentials, or secrets.

## Security and privacy

- [ ] This change does not weaken the existing Electron security controls.
- [ ] This change does not introduce unnecessary permissions.
- [ ] This change does not introduce unexpected network communication.
- [ ] I updated `SECURITY.md` or `PRIVACY.md` if behavior materially changed.

## Dependencies

- [ ] No new runtime dependency is introduced.

If a new dependency is necessary, explain why it is preferable to implementing the required functionality without it.

## Screenshots or evidence

Add screenshots, terminal output, or other evidence when it materially helps review.

## Additional notes

Include anything reviewers should know.
